_budget_note: Workspace monthly limit raised to $47 by the user; $25.72 of study spend before spike-32. Spike capped at $20.00 (ledger includes the $0.48 of the stopped first attempt).
_purpose: 20 sessions of each of five requests, in rounds of 5 (run with --repeats 5, 10, 15, 20; finished runs are skipped). Same claude.ai-style setup as spikes 28-31 (hidden tools + keyword tool_search, reconstructed upload guidance, file inline and on disk, 24 connectors, debrief v2), now with prompt caching (the model sees the same prompt). Added after round 2: i-scripts-upload (method only) and fu-scripts-upload-checksums (F plus 'on the uploaded file'), 10 sessions each, to isolate what makes H work.
